Understanding the map data

The present demonstration uses a community-sourced approximation, not a verified reproduction of the 2026 Survey of India boundaries. The reference standard is the Government of India's officially claimed territorial extent. Current preview data may be incomplete; parts of the claimed area are administered by Pakistan or China.

What is being checked? State/UT names and count, polygon coverage near Gilgit, Muzaffarabad, Aksai Chin and Shaksgam Valley, plus data format. Spatial spot checks are only screening tests.

Next gate: obtain Survey of India's administrative Shapefiles, verify licence terms and compare the geometry with the published 2026 political map. Only then can we describe it as validated.
